newsitem.title: ITALY: Seven dead, 36 injured in Italy holiday bus crash.
newsitem.headline: Seven dead, 36 injured in Italy holiday bus crash.

text.p: Seven people, most believed to be elderly Italian holidaymakers, were killed and 36 injured on Tuesday when a truck collided with their tour bus near this Adriatic port, police said.
Some sixty people were injured in the horrific collision and a resulting pile-up involving some 10 other vehicles.
Police said six of the victims died instantly and a seventh died in hospital.
The bus had stopped outside a motorway tunnel because of mechanical problems when the truck crashed into it, police said.
Two traffic policemen who had arrived to assist the broken-down bus were also injured when the coach was shunted onto their car by the force of the crash.
The truck driver was in serious condition in hospital, police said.
